title: Uniformizer reductions for a trace-normalized fixed presentation
statement: Fix the finite-field/coefficient setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], separated finite-type Noetherian $k$-schemes $X,Y$, and an open/proper factorization $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $p:Z\to Y$ of a smooth separated quasi-compact locally finite-type $k$-morphism $f$ of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$. Assume $\ell$ is invertible in all residue fields of $X,Y$. Let $M$ be a field-shriek model system, $E$ a finite coefficient subfield, $m$ its integral model [def-sp-field-extension-integral-models], $S$ a specified exceptional coefficient ring system, and $T$ a normalized trace-comparison stage of [def-pur-tower-trace-comparison-data]. Assume its unit orientation has PrescribedUnitReductions and that for every finite-Tor integral input $K$, tracePurity of its counitTrace equals its actual tower map. There exist exceptional comparison isomorphisms $e_K:S.G(K)\simeq purAdicTarget(K)$ such that, for every index $n\ge0$ (positive uniformizer exponent $n+1$), $red_n(e_K)\,targetReduction_n=finiteReduction_{T.normal,n}$ and $red_n(tower_K\,e_K)\,targetReduction_n=sourceReduction_n\,finitePurity_n$. All morphisms and source/target comparisons are the literal normalized constructions of that definition node, not unspecified lifts of their finite evaluations.

source.place: Step 4, finite uniformizer reductions, including cofinal comparison with ell-power towers

proof.text: Construct the exceptional target comparison by counit-preserving adjoint uniqueness and the normalized completed exceptional realization. Reduce its counit equation. The normalized finite Hom chain determines the comparison uniquely, identifying its reductions with finiteReduction.

Use the assumed trace-transpose equality to rewrite the whole tower map as tracePurity. Its unit orientation has the prescribed finite reductions, so reduction of its counit trace is finite integration. The normalized K-flat source, tensor and projection comparisons commute with the reduction. Transposition under the finite adjunction therefore gives the specified finite gamma.

Write ell as a unit times the e-th power of a uniformizer. The arithmetic restriction comparison preserves total-limit projections and the reconstruction unit/counit, naturally for whole-system maps. For any positive exponent choose a sufficiently large multiple of e and then apply quotient tensor reassociation. The transition identities make both resulting equations independent of this choice.

theorem fixed_presentation_uniformizer_reductions
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [QuasiCompact (j ≫ p)] [IsSeparated (j ≫ p)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (j ≫ p)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (P.coefficients.l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (P.coefficients.l : Y.residueField y)]
    (S : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.RingSystem P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar
      P.field P.coefficients.different (f := j ≫ p))
    (E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P)
    (m : FieldExtensionTowers.IntegralModel P M E j p d)
    (T : TowerTracePurityComparison.Stage P j p d S M E m)
    (hT : TowerTracePurityComparison.PrescribedUnitReductions P j p d S M E m T
      (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S M E m T))
    (ht : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l E.val Y,
      TowerTracePurityComparison.tracePurity P j p d S M E m T
          (TowerTracePurityComparison.counitTrace P j p d S M E m T
            (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S M E m T)) K =
        TowerTracePurityComparison.tower P j p d S M E m T K) :
    ∃ e : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l E.val Y,
        (((S.operation (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)
          (.integral {carrier := E.val})).G.obj K).obj) ≅
          purAdicTarget P.field P.coefficients E.val (j ≫ p) K.obj,
      (∀ (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l E.val Y) (n : ℕ),
        (scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l E.val X n).map (e K).hom ≫
            purAdicTargetReduction P.field P.coefficients E.val (j ≫ p) d
              K.obj K.property n =
          WeilConjectures.RealizedTowerPurity.finiteReduction P.field P.coefficients
            E.val (j ≫ p) S (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) T.normal K n) ∧
      ∀ (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l E.val Y) (n : ℕ),
        (scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l E.val X n).map
            (TowerTracePurityComparison.tower P j p d S M E m T K ≫
              (e K).hom) ≫
            purAdicTargetReduction P.field P.coefficients E.val (j ≫ p) d
              K.obj K.property n =
          purAdicSourceReduction P.field P.coefficients E.val (j ≫ p) d
            K.obj K.property n ≫
            (purAdicFiniteArrow P.field P.coefficients E.val (j ≫ p) d
              K.obj K.property n).hom
